svg.title: V-20. HSI responsibilities · hardware, software, detection (SysML v2 view hsiResponsibilities)
svg.desc: HSI responsibilities view generated from the SysML v2 model. One row per interface HSI-01 to HSI-14 of WP-S-05 §11.4: what the hardware provides and the software must do, each with its owner elements (chips coloured by integrity), how a failure of the other side is detected (red where it is not detected today), the reaction, resources shared with another interface, and the status of the row: in place, partial or missing.
svg.text: V-20 · HSI responsibilities · hardware, software, detection
The 14 interfaces of WP-S-05 §11.4: what the hardware provides and the software must do, their owner elements, who detects a failure and the reaction
SPI4 slave and DMA2 streams into the SRAM1/2 buffers (§3, §8)
Check every transfer and bound every length against the MCU buffer
(TSR-410, 412); keep the DMA buffers apart from the safety state
Transfer refused (NACK) and counted; an error
Nothing beyond HSI-01: requests arrive on SPI endpoint 0
Accept only the requests the mode allows (TSR-512, 513) and
Authority revoked with the siren (TSR-516); a
refused request leaves the state unchanged
CAN packet stream over SPI endpoints
Nothing beyond HSI-01: CAN packets on SPI endpoints 1 and 3
Unpack the stream and pass every actuation frame through the TX
Frame rejected and returned to the SoC; a rate
Shared: One TX queue for forwarded and
FDCAN1–3 controllers with the CAN CRC, error counters and
bus-off, and the transceiver enable lines (§5)
Check every RX message the envelope uses (TSR-401…406), forward
camera frames unchanged (TSR-704, 707), send only through the TX
HW: CAN CRC and error confinement; SW:
An RX fault revokes authority; bus-off is counted
and the core reset, a safety reaction is required
Open-drain GPIO driving the intercept relay in the harness;
released at reset (to be confirmed, AOU-13)
Drive the relay only in a car mode with a harness detected, and release
it in SILENT, NOOUTPUT and ELM327 and in the safe state (TSR-506,
Relay released: the stock camera path is
ADC1 channels 4 and 17 on the SBU lines (§6)
Detect the orientation while the relay is not driven, map CAN and relay
pins to it, and re-initialise on a change (TSR-701)
CAN re-initialised and the safety mode
Digital input on the SBU ignition line
Use the line to select the heartbeat timeouts and the power state
Not detected: no plausibility check of the
SoC GPIOs to NRST and BOOT0; ST ROM bootloader on BOOT0
Keep the MCU outputs safe during reset and boot (TSR-502,
HWSR-502c) and keep flash closed to the ROM bootloader (TSR-511)
SW: reset cause reported in the health
Restart in SILENT with the relay released; RDP
IWDG1 window watchdog, 90 ms nominal, on its own clock
Start it at the first relay drive and service it only after the 100 Hz safety
MCU reset: relay released, restart in SILENT
Fault vectors (NMI, HardFault), clock security system, die
Classify each fault and take the safe state (TSR-502…505, 509); today
HW: CSS and fault vectors; SW: counters
NMI and HardFault reset the MCU; the other
faults are reported only, a reaction is required
Shared: The speaker with the SoC's audio
DAC with DMA and an audio codec over I2C5, or an amplifier, to
Sound the siren when authority is revoked or the EPS fault persists
Not detected: no feedback from the
speaker; a start-up test is required
Flash bank 1: bootstub in sector 0, application from
Verify the application's signature before it runs (TSR-511, 514) and its
The bootstub does not start the application and
ADC1 with an input divider on the supply; BOR and PVD in the
Measure the supply and take the safe state outside the operating
SW: ADC reading on each health request;
BOR and PVD are not configured yet
Required: safe state outside the range
Configure MPU regions so DMA and non-safety code cannot reach the
safety state, and handle ECC errors (TSR-503, 507)
HW: MPU fault and ECC error, once
14 interfaces: 1 in place, 12 partial, 1 missing; at 3 a failure of the other side is not detected today.
